programs.description: A wealthy businessman falls in love with a humble woman, but their romance faces hurdles when he learns of her health issues.
Vedavalli is the rich and powerful landlord of the village. After a few altercations between her daughter and Ponnurasu, a villager, Vedavalli swears to ruin Ponnurasu's family.
Aravind and Parthasarathy become friends in jail and continue to follow the path of crime after their release. When Aravind decides to change his lifestyle, his friend refuses to mend his ways.
Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.
Karna, a labourer, marries his employer's daughter. However, his father-in-law creates problems between Karna and his sister.
After studying in London, Ranjani falls in love with Allimuthu, a local dancer from India. However, her brother goes against their alliance and hatches a plan to separate them.
Baasha is the local gangster of a village. However, when Palanisamy shifts to the village, he strives to save the villagers from the wrath of the gangster.
Sanjay, a young man, falls in love with Nithi, his childhood friend, and cannot imagine a life without her. However, he hesitates to confess his feelings out of the fear of losing their friendship.

Shiva, an intelligence officer, develops a phone software that helps him track those in need of help. He sets out to save the people of Hyderabad when he realises that a serial killer is on the loose.

Pandiyan, who lost his mother at a young age, becomes a conman to educate his sister. However, his life turns upside down when he is unable to settle the dowry for his sister's marriage.

A compassionate landlord helps a struggling student achieve her dream of studying medicine. However, as he develops feelings for her, the village chief plans to marry his son to the newly qualified doctor.
Jeeva runs away to the city to avoid an arranged marriage. Soon, he befriends Singam, a local goon, after which, they get involved in many mishaps together.

Vallavan, from a modest background, falls for Charmy, the daughter of a powerful minister, but their love faces intense opposition, leading to a battle against family pressures.
Sethupathi, a brave cop, saves the prime minister's life from an attack. Later, he faces a dangerous terrorist seeking revenge, racing to stop the criminal's deadly plans.
Aalwar, a temple priest, leads a peaceful life until his mother and sister are murdered. In an attempt to take revenge, he adopts various disguises to teach a lesson to the perpetrators.

Divya is a lively young girl, who secretly mourns the death of her lover. She reluctantly agrees to an arranged marriage with Chandrakumar and faces difficulties.
A simple mechanic falls in love with a young girl. However, her father, who owns a television channel, opposes their relationship and enlists the help of a man to separate them.

An architect falls for a psychiatry student, but his uncle, who is his only guardian, arranges his marriage in a wealthy family. He tries to woo the parents of the girl he loves but then his uncle ruins his plans.
When Sumati and her son move into the house opposite theirs, Gayatri gets shocked to learn that she is her husband, Sivaramakrishnan's first wife.
Chandru's friends make fun of him as he does not have a girlfriend. He points out at a girl claiming that she is his girlfriend, due to which a number of unfortunate events take place in her life.
Kadhiravan and his friend, Mohan, fight against the atrocities of a corrupt politician. Mohan gets killed and Kadhiravan plots revenge against the politician and his men.
Dheena is the adopted brother of a local gangster, Aathi, and together they rule over a town. However, their relationship turns sour because of a misunderstanding between them.
Raja, a jobless youth, and his well-educated cousin, Ramesh, fall in love with Latha, a distant relative. The two brothers compete against each other to win over her love.

After failing to pursue their dreams, two people run away from their respective homes. When they happen to travel on the same train, an unexpected incident changes the course of their lives.
Elango, the son of a conservative village head, falls in love with Sandhya, the daughter of a local priest. However, his family opposes their union and torments Sandhya's family.
Murthy earns his living by going to jail for the mistakes of other people. He agrees to act as Ramanathan's son, Santhosh, who is wanted dead by Dhanushkodi.
In a bid to seek revenge for a past misdeed, a man asks his nephew to woo the daughter of his enemy. However, complications arise when his nephew really falls in love with the girl.
When police officer Sethupathi is transferred to a village, he learns about the complete lack of law and order in his jurisdiction. Unperturbed, he decides to turn things around and establish peace.
Kandasamy is desperate to enrol his son in a good school. Trouble ensues when his wife spots him with an educated woman who is posing as their child's mother in order to help him get admission.
Vetrivel, a respected man, dearly loves his brother and sacrifices his love for him. Problems arise when his brother, Subramaniyam, starts suspecting him of having an affair with his wife Gowri.
Pandian falls in love with his neighbour, Maithili, and anonymously helps her continue her education. However, Pandian's roommate, Prakash, gets all the credits for his good deeds.

After his wife is murdered by Thanga Malai Annachi and his gang, Eesa, a salt pan worker, embarks on a vengeful journey by systematically hunting down each killer to seek justice for her death.
Naga, a thug, assists a corrupt officer in kidnapping a journalist who exposed him. However, after witnessing the officer's unethical behaviour, Naga resolves to mend his ways.
A brain-dead youth's family agrees to donate his heart to a girl who needs an immediate heart transplant. A disparate group of people decide to complete this task by racing against time.
A lazy man parades around as a beggar with false ailments, and he chances upon an opportunity to infiltrate a rich household. But he doesn't realise that he's walked into a web of conspiracies.
Dhuruvan is a forest ranger who trains NCC cadets. On a trek with five college girls, he stumbles upon a gang of terrorists who plan to foil a rocket launch by ISRO.
A don dispatches four criminals to a village to retrieve buried treasure. However, they resolve to deceive him and divide the wealth.
Manohar constantly finds himself in a tussle with Keerthana, an egoistical woman, but eventually falls in love with her. However, she is far from believing he is good enough for her.
Karunakaran is an intelligent youth who cannot tolerate injustice. He leaves his hometown and joins a college in Chennai, but soon gets involved with a group of corrupt policemen.

A mother with an obedient son wants an equally docile daughter-in-law. However, things become complicated when he marries a woman who is the complete opposite.
Dissatisfied with the proposals coming her way, Bama elopes with Gopalakrishnan on a whim. Trouble follows when Bama starts suspecting Gopalakrishnan's innocent nature based purely on suggestions.
An entrepreneur challenges his reckless son, Satyam, to live independently for three months. Satyam's varied encounters end up changing him as a human being.
After witnessing the rich being set free despite committing various crimes, Kanagavel decides to take matters into his own hands.
Kannayiram, a powerful gangster, kills Ramasamy, for not giving up his land to him. After hearing this news, Shiva, Ramasamy's brother, flees the military camp to avenge his brother's death.
Chellaiya is hell-bent on taking revenge on his uncle Masilamani and his two sons for backstabbing his father. However, things are not as easy as they seem.
Vasanth learns that the girl he is in love with is his close friend Shankar's sister. When Shankar shares his bitter past with Vasanth, he decides to sacrifice his love to protect his friendship.
Circumstances force Anwar to join a terrorist organisation. However, things change when he double-crosses them to avenge the death of his family.
